name: goal-d1-higher-order-hyp

import Prelude
def h (f : (Nat → Nat) → Nat) : Nat := by
  exact f (fun x => x)
note: D1 (task 26 review): a hypothesis whose type is a higher-order Pi. The arrow domain must be parenthesised — `(Nat → Nat) → Nat`, not `Nat → Nat → Nat` (arrows associate to the right, so the bare form is a different type). Caret at the step start, so the state before `exact` is shown.
